verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph, OneDrive's own API, documents change notifications that alert applications when a resource is created, updated, or deleted, which is the core of event subscription. The excerpt does not say these are registrable HTTP webhook endpoints, and does not confirm that OneDrive driveItems are a supported resource. Delta query is polling-based change tracking, so it is not credited as webhooks. missing for 10: explicit documentation of HTTP callback/subscription registration, confirmation that driveItem/drive resources are supported, details on validation and renewal, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Change notifications enable applications to receive alerts when a Microsoft Graph resource they're interested in changes; that is, created, updated, or deleted.
with Microsoft Graph, you can use a single API to work with them.
